title: Tetris DS (USA) (NDS, ATRE)
status: static analysis of the ARM9 binary (overlay 0 = Standard mode, capstone ARM) cross-checked with the community Action Replay codes (ATRE-0a3e4826); not yet read from a running game
notes: Standard mode (Marathon / Line Clear / VS CPU) lives in ARM9 overlay 0 (RAM 0x0210B800, strings ct_*/std_vs*). Its work area is the 512 KiB BSS of overlay 12 at 0x0217CC80 (the overlay-0 global 0x021314B4 holds that pointer). Player records start at work+0xF08 = 0x0217DB88 with a 0x300 stride (4 slots for Wi-Fi; VS CPU drives slot 0 with the pad at 0x0210A3B8 and slot 1 with the CPU at 0x02117880). The mode main loops are the function table at 0x020720D8: Marathon 0x02116B14 (ends at lines >= 200), Line Clear 0x02116538 (ends at lines >= 25), VS CPU 0x02115A64.

state.evidence: 0x02113658 is the only writer of 7 (strb #7,[r0,#0x1aa]); it is called from 0x021127d8 when state 4 cannot place the new piece (0x02119df8 = fit test) and from 0x02112d8c when the falling piece (state 2) no longer fits. VS CPU 0x02115cb8: match over when slot 0 or slot 1 state == 7; slot 1 == 7 takes the win branch. Wi-Fi targeting 0x0210fc88 skips slots whose state == 7.
state.confidence: high (static); value 7 lasts at least the 20-frame KO animation (counter +0x114 to 0x14) before the result screen

score.evidence: score widget bound to work+0x10B4 at 0x0210c284; high-score entry reads it at 0x0211682c; AR 'Max Score' 0217DD34

lines.evidence: Line Clear loop 0x02116690: lines (work+0x10B8) compared with 25; Marathon 0x02116d28 compares with 200; AR '199 Lines' 9217DD38/2217DD38

piece.evidence: 0x02119fd4 pops the queue at +0x214 into +0x19C, zeroes the rotation (+0x19D) and sets state 4; AR 'Always <colour> Block' writes 2217DD24 and 2217DDA8

next_queue.evidence: queue object passed to 0x0202879c/0x020287f4 on spawn; its +0xC byte (0x0217DDA8) is the queue head the AR block codes also pin

game_type.evidence: work+0x7DEDC, written at each mode start next to the work pointer: Marathon 0x02116b44 (0), VS CPU 0x02115a98 (1), Line Clear 0x0211656c (3); the KO code compares it with 4/5
game_type.confidence: high for 0/1/3, low for the multiplayer values

cpu_level.evidence: work+0x7DED8; VS CPU win branch indexes the CPU table at 0x02131520 with it

local_slot.evidence: work+0x7DEE0; Wi-Fi code multiplies it by the 0x300 stride

vs_cpu.save_state: Standard > VS CPU, parked at the first piece of a match

sprint.save_state: Standard > Marathon (or Line Clear), parked at the first piece

win.why: two lines cleared: a round of a few seconds
